statement: For every fixed real 0<=p<1 and every hardwired rational 0<q<=1-p, the explicit deterministic zero-true-query algorithm in research/quadratic-resolution-proof.md always outputs a spanning path on every observed input. For every n>=2, every genuine finite n-point metric d, and every omniscient decrease-only adversary choosing finite observations after seeing the independent pair mask and before any private bits, E_mask[cost_d(P)] <= 10^15 q^-5 max(1,log_2 n)^2 MST(d). Every execution uses at most n^(a_q max(1,log_2 n)) exact arithmetic/comparison and bit operations for a constant a_q depending only on q and the fixed implementation, independent of true and observed aspect ratios; private-bit cost is zero. The literal n=2, R>n, U=0 and p=0 cases are included. This completely proves immutable source.md with a quadratic rather than fourth-power logarithm. The structural lemma in Section 7 states that every compatible DFS leaf path in any nested dyadic hierarchy with the stated hidden-core size, diameter and outlier assumptions has cost(P)<=2 beta H+12 beta Omega, where Omega=sum_(i,C) 2^i |C minus core_i(C)| and H=sum_i 2^i |C_i|.
contribution: Proposed full computational-noise-range resolution and quadratic logarithmic approximation versus arXiv:2610.40594v1 Theorem 1.3, which gives a quasipolynomial fourth-power bound for p<=0.1. A uniform unmarked-rectangle bootstrap and high quantiles support all p<1. Deterministic DFS leaf extraction charges final path degree two and contiguous child intervals; retaining actual outlier counts and separating generated clusters from leftover singletons improves the same coherent method from the earlier cubic estimate to quadratic. The hierarchy, future consistency, normalization and promotion/intersection framework are inherited and credited. This is one strongest same-original claim, not a separate marginal result or an assertion of fresh acceptance or STOC readiness. Novelty, substantive value and venue significance require new actual review; the adjacent SODA full-proof access gap remains explicit.
